name: Ho Chi Minh City
provinceNote: The city now includes the former Ba Ria–Vung Tau and Binh Duong provinces. The center visitors walk is still District 1.
summary: Ho Chi Minh City is Vietnam’s largest city and the usual end of a north-to-south trip. District 1 holds the Opera House, Dong Khoi, and Ben Thanh Market. Three days covers the center, a museum, and either Cu Chi or a delta day.
fee: Walking is free; museums and Cu Chi are ticketed
getThere: Tan Son Nhat Airport is inside the city, often 30–60 minutes to District 1
seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City travel guide — what to do, how to get there, where to eat
seoDescription: How to spend three days in Ho Chi Minh City, where to stay in District 1, and which day trips are worth leaving town for.
intro: The city is still called Saigon by many residents, and that name fits the center: a tight commercial downtown that grew under French rule and then kept growing. The walkable visitor core is District 1. Cholon, the Chinese commercial district, is a separate half-day.

Eat com tam, broken rice, and a bowl of pho in the south’s sweeter style. Use the War Remnants Museum if you want the documentary record, and allow time; it is not a light hour. The Reunification Palace is the other standard stop, a preserved 1960s government building.
gettingAround: Tan Son Nhat is close by Asian-capital standards and still slow at rush hour. GrabCar is the default. Walking works inside District 1 if you treat motorbike traffic as the rule of the road: cross with a steady pace, not a dash.
The first metro line is useful on its own corridor and does not link every sight. For Cu Chi and the delta, book a car or a tour rather than improvising at the bus station with luggage.

stayAreas.name: District 1
stayAreas.summary: The practical base. Walk to dinner. Book a street set back from the night clubs if you want sleep.

stayAreas.name: District 3
stayAreas.summary: Quieter streets, a short ride from the center, better if you want local cafes.

eat: Southern food is sweeter and more herb-heavy. Com tam, banh xeo, hu tieu, and a late bowl of pho are the city set.
Ben Thanh’s stalls are convenient and priced for visitors. Walk a few blocks to a com tam room with a lunch queue.
interestsBody: Food, markets, and the city’s war-history museums. The beach is not here; Vung Tau and Phu Quoc are separate rides or flights.

faqs.q: Is Ho Chi Minh City the same as Saigon?
faqs.a: Saigon is the older name and still the everyday name for the center. Ho Chi Minh City is the official name, and after 2025 it covers a wider area than the downtown you will walk.

faqs.q: How many days do you need?
faqs.a: Three days for the center and one excursion. Add a night in Can Tho if the delta is more than a checkbox.
